snip.t: Severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) — adenosine deaminase (ADA) deficiency.
(a) Gout (b) Lesch-Nyhan syndrome (c) Severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) (d) Orotate aciduria (e) Associated with severe mental retardation and hyperuricemia
Severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) may be due to adenosine deaminase (ADA) deficiency in about half of cases.

qs.q: A patient with severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) due to a defect in the common gamma chain lacks functional T and NK cells. Which cytokine signaling pathway is primarily disrupted?
o: Tumor necrosis factor and lymphotoxin pathways
qs.e: The common gamma chain is shared by receptors for IL-2, 4, 7, 9, 15, and 21, crucial for lymphocyte development.
